value.rationale: A natural semantic invariant—whether three full modal operations determine the fourth on a fixed intuitionistic frame—has an exact, nontrivial threshold between two and three worlds in the exact confluence regimes of the motivating 2026 work. One fixed chain and one-edge changes give a uniform reusable minimal obstruction for all four modalities. This yields information absent from larger qualitative nondefinability examples and a structural basis for small-frame testing; no paper-sized downstream theorem is asserted.
